faq_heading: Abbotsford houses under $1 million: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Abbotsford houses sell for under $1,000,000?
faq.a: 241 of 591, or 41%. A further 179 sold in the next range up, $1,000,000 to $1,199,999.

faq.q: What is the median price of a house in Abbotsford?
faq.a: $1,050,000 from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, so $1,000,000 is below the middle of the market. The middle half sold between $921,406 and $1,249,500.

faq.q: Which Abbotsford area has the lowest house prices?
faq.a: Poplar, at $925,000 across 18 sales at $408 a square foot, median year built 1986. The highest of the 4 lowest was Abbotsford West at $1,023,564.

faq.q: How fast do Abbotsford houses sell?
faq.a: 23 days at the median, closing at 96.8% of the last list price, with 6% above list.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. A median is shown only where at least 5 homes sold. The live search is not connected yet (Jerry’s saved search, price filter $1,000,000).

In Abbotsford, 241 of the 591 houses (41%) sold under $1,000,000. The median was $1,050,000, with the middle half between $921,406 and $1,249,500. The busiest price range, $800,000 to $999,999, had 211 sales.

blocks.text: Buying a house under $1,000,000 in Abbotsford

In Poplar the median house sold for $925,000 across 18 sales, $75,000 under $1,000,000. Across Abbotsford the median house took 23 days to sell and closed at 96.8% of the last list price, with 6% of the 591 sales above list. Check the roof age and foundation.
